created_prompt: Julie posts cooking videos to 1.2M followers who love her quick, healthy recipes. Over the next three years she wants to grow online and publish a cookbook (torn on traditional vs. self-publishing). She works four days weekly, with limited time and budget. Given this information, I want you to act as a career coach and mentor, and give me a concrete three-year action plan broken down into monthly actions for Julie, that are both achievable and realistic. This action plan should culminate in Julie being able to publish a cookbook AND grow her online channel. As she is torn between traditional or self-publishing, you need to be clear on the pros and cons of each, and if the three-year plan needs to branch at any point, make that clear within the plan itself.
